modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Each fare-paying customer may take one cabin bag unless the operator directs it to be stowed in the hold.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: One piece not exceeding a depth of 9 inches, height of 14 inches and length of 16 inches.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: The free checked allowance is the one posted at intercaribbean.com; excess baggage travels subject to space and may not go on your flight.

size_weight.value: Any bag must not exceed 157 cm in total linear dimensions (length plus width plus height) or 70 pounds in weight; bags over either limit are not accepted at check-in.

excess_limit.value: Total baggage over 220 pounds is not accepted as excess baggage and must be sent as cargo.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: interCaribbean sells Saver, Best and Flex fares; Saver is the lowest price.

cheapest_fare.value: Saver Fare: non-refundable and valid for 90 days. 7 day advance purchase and a round trip purchase are required. Changes cost $50 (international) or $20 (domestic) plus any fare difference. A no-show forfeits 100% of the fare, taxes and surcharges. Seat selection is free; the 2nd bag cannot be prepaid.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

delays.value: interCaribbean's contract of carriage says it accepts no liability for costs or losses from flight delays but will use every effort to carry you and your allowed baggage on its next available flight. It is not liable for any costs or losses when flights are delayed, rescheduled or cancelled due to weather.

online_checkin.value: Online check-in opens 36 hours before scheduled departure (24 hours for flights departing San Juan, SJU).

counters_open.value: Airport check-in counters open 2.5 hours before scheduled departure.

checkin_close.value: Check-in and baggage acceptance close 60 minutes before departure for international flights and 30 minutes before for domestic flights within the Turks and Caicos Islands. Customers arriving later may be unable to travel.
